title: Senior Product Manager, Core Platform - 100% Remote - EMEA
description:
NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within EMEA. 
 Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth. 
 Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here . 
 About the role 
 We are seeking a commercially minded, technically fluent, and detail-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and delivery for the core product domain at Hostaway. 
 This is the part of the platform our customers open first each morning: where they set prices, open or close dates, write the rules that govern each stay, and build the listings that go out to every channel they sell on. It directly affects their earnings and helps them turn empty calendars into fully booked ones. 
 In this role, you will define the vision, roadmap and execution across pricing, availability and listing content. Pricing and availability come first, and listings sit in the same experience layer under the same standard. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and the teams responsible for channel connections to build experiences property managers can trust without needing to double-check their wor k. 
 You'll also take on build missions, using our AI tooling to carry an idea all the way from discovery and prototype to shipped product, with engineers beside you 
 5+ years of product management experience in B2B software, ideally for professional users who rely on the product all day. 
 Experience owning a broad product area with multiple connected workflows, not just a single feature, and making complex systems easier to understand and use, especially where external platforms behave differently. 
 You build with AI as part of your daily workflow, comfortable going from idea to clickable or working prototype with AI coding tools, and excited by the idea of a PM who ships, not just specs . 
 Enough technical fluency to work confidently with engineers on APIs and integrations; you won’t build them yourself. 
 Run continuous discovery as your default operating mode .  
 Sound judgment on trade-offs, and the resilience to work through long-standing problems in a product customers depend on. 
 Nice to have 
 Experience in travel, hospitality, vacation rentals or marketplaces. 
 Work on pricing, rates, distribution or inventory, properties, rooms, vehicles or equipment. 
 You don’t need to come from vacation-rental software. We’re interested in people who can simplify complex systems and strengthen a product their customers depend on. 
 What we offer 
 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant. 
 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one). 
 Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success. 
 Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions. 
 Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities. 
 Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms. 
 Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant. 
 Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here). 
 Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
**The role and the team**
As a Senior AI Product Manager (all genders), you'll help drive the vision for Lucanet's Intelligence Core and Lume and turn it into trusted, high-impact features for finance teams who cannot afford wrong answers. AI is already central to Lucanet, and the Intelligence Core and Lume, the shared AI capability our products and agents build on, is among the most advanced in the industry. This is a remote role in Germany.
You'll work in a small, highly talented AI product team and coordinate AI initiatives across R&D, alongside Engineering, Delivery, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams. You lead through influence rather than formal authority. The team values pragmatic, collaborative people who stay comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy working at the fast-moving edge of AI. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.
#### **What you'll do**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle for Lucanet's Intelligence Core and Lume, our shared AI capability.
* Prioritize AI features with data-driven frameworks, tie each to a business outcome, and review adoption after launch.
* Own the AI evaluation strategy, offline with curated datasets and benchmarks and online with live production quality signals.
* Define and mature LLMOps best practices across the agent and product lifecycle, and centralize AI product reporting.
* Run customer discovery and early-access programs with working prototypes to validate solutions before committing to a path.
* Coordinate AI initiatives across R&D and align Product, Engineering, Delivery, and go-to-market teams.
* Track the AI frontier, including models, research, tooling, and competitor launches, and turn it into concrete opportunities.
* Contribute to AI pricing and packaging and enable Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success with value-proposition briefs.
You'll report into the Product AI leadership team.
**What you bring**
***You have***
* Owned the roadmap and lifecycle of an enterprise software product, from discovery to launch, using customer discovery and product analytics to reach measurable business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of modern AI/ML (LLMs, RAG, agents, agentic harness, prompt and context engineering, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs), with depth in at least one area such as Agent UX, LLMOps, or AI evaluation.
* Track the AI frontier (new model releases, research, tooling, techniques) and quickly judge what matters for finance use cases.
* Use LLMs and AI tools daily, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, to change how you work and turn ideas into working demos in hours.
* A pragmatic, collaborative, low-ego mindset: you're comfortable with ambiguity, lead through influence without formal authority, and keep learning at the fast-moving edge of AI.
* Advanced English (C1).
***It's a plus if you also have***
* A genuine passion for AI: you experiment with new models and tools, follow the field closely (papers, releases, communities), and form your own views on where it's heading.
**Perks at work**
* Flexible and hybrid working: our Lucaflex model lets you plan your working hours and location according to your needs and professional responsibilities.
* Remote work from another country: work up to 90 days a year outside your home country, supported by our partner Workflex.
* Professional development budget: get dedicated time, resources and budget to build the skills for your career path.
* Structured development process: quarterly catch-ups with your manager, built on clear expectations for impact, competence and influence.
* Paid volunteer days: take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.
* Health and wellbeing support: access company wellbeing programs, sport subsidies and mental health support through external partners.
* Paid vacation days: take 30 days a year to rest, travel and recharge.
* Pension support: build your retirement savings with employer pension contributions.
* Corporate discounts platform: get exclusive discounts across travel, retail, technology, and more.
#LI-Remote #LI-AA1

Lucanet is the CFO solution platform for modern finance and tax teams, automating processes from consolidation and financial planning to tax compliance, ESG reporting, and cash management. More than 6,000 companies worldwide rely on our easy-to-use, out-of-the-box SaaS platform. We're PE-backed and growing across global markets.
Behind the platform is a global team of 900+ people who care about doing the work well. We challenge each other to move fast without cutting corners and build solutions that change how finance and tax leaders operate. If you want your work to have real reach, and your growth is important to you, Lucanet is the right place for you.
Discover more about Lucanet as an employer.

Everybody is different here and we like it that way. We welcome people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, religion, age, and disability, exactly as they are. What you bring is what matters. If you need an adjustment to take part in our hiring process, let us know. See yourself in this role? We want to hear from you.

title: Product Manager - Agent Productivity (f/m/x)
description:
Welcome to Tourlane! We're a traveltech company on a mission to provide the best experience in travel.
We know that vacation time is precious. Our goal is to help customers discover the world and create lasting memories. That’s why our ambition is to offer the best experience in travel by empowering travel planners to craft extraordinary, personalized journeys that go beyond the ordinary, because we believe life is too short for standard travel.
We provide fully personalized, multi-stop trips to 60 destinations around the world and counting. With over 150,000 travelers in the DACH region, France and the US, we’re on our way to becoming Europe’s, and the World's, leading travel company.
We are looking for a **Product Manager (f/m/x) with focus on Agent Productivity**. You will own the products that decide how our Travel Experts spend their day: when they talk to customers, how this experience is shaped from customer and agent perspective, which customers agents talk to, and how little time they lose in between.
Your first big mission is to change how our customers are connected to our Travel Experts. Today every customer call is tied to one named agent days in advance. When a customer does not show up, that time is lost for us. This is a core efficiency problem we want to solve and you will take a leading role for this from product side
Besides this core mission, your end to end ownership for the agent productivity area has the goal to change how our sales organisation structures their work and how our tools can support to make the communication and experience with our customers as efficient and smooth as possible.
**WHAT IS THE ROLE ABOUT?**
* **Product ownership:** Own the Agent Productivity area and shape the core experience between our customers and Travel Experts as a key conversion point in our customer journey. You will be responsible for products and services like Travel Expert calendar and shift management, matching logic between customers & Travel Experts, Zoom Contact Center, our Pre-Sales tool and processes, and the CRM nurturing flows around the customer calls.
* **Change how Travel Experts works, not just the software:** Many of your solutions live in processes as much as in code: shift templates, protected quoting time, how pre-sales books calls. You shape them together with Sales Ops, Sales leadership and our pre-sales partner, and you bring the agents along.
* **Measure what matters:** Own a clear metric tree, from opportunities per agent per day to customer show up rate and conversion guardrails. Where tracking does not exist yet, you make sure it gets built, so every decision rests on data.
* **Prototype before you specify:** Use AI tools to build clickable or working prototypes of flows, messages and agent screens. Test them with agents and customers, then hand your engineering team a prototype plus a lean spec instead of a long document.
* **Put AI to work in the agent workflow:** Find the places where automation and AI agents can take manual work off our Travel Experts.
* **Work AI-native yourself:** Use AI for research synthesis, data analysis, documentation and stakeholder updates.
* **Lead your team:** Work with an engineering team, an Engineering Manager and a designer, and with partners in CRM, Data and Tech. Set clear goals and make trade-offs visible.
**WHAT WILL YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL?**
* 4+ years in product management, with at least one product you owned end to end where process change mattered as much as the software, e.g. sales or service tooling.
* Proven AI fluency. AI is part of how you work every day, and you can show it to us.
* Comfort with data: you define metrics and read pilot and experiment results critically.
* Strong judgment on scope: you cut a big idea into stages, know what to leave out, and can explain why.
* Experience driving change with operational department stakeholders.
* Excellent communication in English. German is a strong plus, since you will work closely with German-speaking agents. French is a plus.
* Nice to have: experience with Zoom Contact Center or other call infrastructure, Salesforce, CRM tools such as Braze, previous roles in the travel industry.
**What we offer:**
------------------
* Flexible working setup to get the most of your working hours: we offer full flexibility in our Hybrid/Remote model, however we do expect that you take advantage of our lively Berlin office 2 days per week.
* Access to internal travel discounts on our platform plus outside travel industry discounts on hotels, rentals, transport and a lot more.
* Annual €1500 self-development budget.
* We share your passion for traveling: enjoy working abroad through our program (5 months per year, inside and outside of EU!).
* We support all the diverse communities that make us Tourlane: 40+ Language's and Cultures represented at our HQ.
* Dog-friendly office: we can't wait to meet your furry friend!

title: Senior Product Manager (F/M/D)
description:
Work smart, have fun and make an impact!
 EcoVadis is the leading provider of business sustainability ratings . Our solutions are backed by an international team of experts and powerful technology. We analyze data and build sustainability scorecards that give companies actionable insights into their environmental, social and ethical risks.
 Why apply to EcoVadis? Be a part of the global sustainability change in business. Grow your career. Work with extraordinary people. Feel valued for your contribution.
Learn more about our team and culture on EcoVadis careers page.
 Job Description
 As a Senior Product Manager for one of our Strategic Use Cases, you will own that use case end-to-end — from the customer problem and the data it depends on, through prototype, roadmap and launch, to the outcome in the market. You will work alongside senior engineers and product experts to define the ambition, understand requirements and launch innovative new products.
This is a builder role, not a coordination role. We're looking for a high-agency generalist who prototypes before they debate, uses AI to move at a different speed, engages customers directly, and takes full ownership of outcomes — not output.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Own the vision: Set and drive the aligned, end-to-end vision for your use case (regulatory due diligence, human rights due diligence, decarbonization or resilience)— what the customer experience should be, where the gaps are, and the sequence from parity to leadership. 
 Understand the market: Understand the technical requirements of your use case, and how other competitors and customers are currently solving it. Take inspiration from everywhere, including partner discussions, conferences, webinars and other resources. 
 Engage customers directly: Spend real time with buyers, program owners and co-development accounts. Validate problems and solutions first-hand; and build interest from customers and prospects. 
 Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools to build working demos, spin up lightweight services and test your own assumptions before committing engineering. Show the team what's possible by doing it, not describing it. 
 Drive the build forward: Work alongside engineering to unblock and drive the build forward, working across multiple areas of the product and platform, collaborating with other tribes and squads whilst executing independently or in partnership. 
 Partner on go-to-market: Work hand-in-hand with the Strategic Use Case Leads and commercial teams to land what you build. 
 Own the outcome: Define the measures of success, hold yourself and the circle to them, and lead clean persist / pivot / stop decisions. 
 Who You Are
 A generalist builder at heart — you move fluidly between strategy, data, prototype and GTM, and you'd rather build a rough thing that teaches you something than debate a perfect thing that doesn't. 
 An AI-native operator — AI is woven through how you work: discovery, analysis, prototyping, instrumentation and communication. 
 Customer-obsessed — you get your conviction from talking to real customers, not from the building. 
 Biased to speed — you move decisively with incomplete information, tell reversible decisions from irreversible ones, and update fast when you're wrong. Strong opinions, loosely held. 
 Comfortable without full control — part of your use case's scope and experience will always be owned by other squads. You see managing that, as the craft. 
 Mission-driven — you want your work to help guide all companies toward a sustainable world, and to help EcoVadis lead the market in getting there. 
 AI fluency we hire for
 We expect you to operate at the AI-Fluent to AI-Native end of the spectrum: you don't just use AI for one-off tasks, you reconstruct core PM workflows around it — agents configured with your product context, personas and prior research; machine-testable acceptance criteria; reusable workflows you share with the squad. At the top of this ladder, the PM shifts from feature author to outcome orchestrator — concentrating on strategic trade-offs and novel bets while agents carry more of the discovery and synthesis.
 Qualifications
 Typically 10+ years experience, including a track record owning a meaningful product area end-to-end in B2B enterprise SaaS, with real business and customer outcomes to point to. 
 Enough technical fluency to build — you can prototype with AI tooling, LLM APIs and a scripting language (Python / JavaScript or equivalent) without waiting for engineering to validate every idea. 
 An AI-native way of working that's already part of how you operate, not an aspiration. 
 Comfort operating in a regulated, data-rich, sustainability or risk domain — or the curiosity and speed to get there fast. 
 Sharp problem framing and communication — you walk into the room with a recommendation, not an open question, and you make engineering and design faster by reducing ambiguity. 
 Be fluent in English (as our primary working language). 
 Additional Information
 In return for your expertise, we offer:
 Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment
 Flexible working hours
 Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing
 Access to professional mental health support
 Referral bonus policy
 Learning and development 
 Sustainability events and community involvement
 Peer recognition program
 Employee-led resource groups
 Remote work from abroad policy 
 Hybrid work organization (2 office days per week)
 Health coverage and optional pension scheme
 Internet and electricity bill allowance 
 Subsidized travel and BahnCard 50
 JobRad bike leasing program
 Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership
 Community service day when volunteering. 
 Life Insurance

title: Product Owner – B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns 
 CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.
 Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.
 Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.
 Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.
 Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Backlog und Tickets 
 Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.
 Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.
 Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.
 Konzeption 
 Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.
 Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.
 Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.
 Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.
 Planung und Steuerung 
 Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.
 Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.
 Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.
 Schnittstellen 
 Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.
 Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.
 Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.
 Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.
 Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.
 Deine ersten Monate 
 In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.
 Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.
 Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.
 Das bringst du mit 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.
 Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.
 Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.
 Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.
 Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.
 Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.
 Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.
 Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, unsere technische Dokumentation ist auf Englisch.
 Was wir dir bieten 
 Sinnvolle Arbeit mit Impact : ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt, das Menschen schützt
 Echte Verantwortung : du gestaltest die Produktarbeit bei uns von Grund auf
 Flexibles Arbeiten : remote, hybrid oder in unserem Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg
 Faires Gesamtpaket : marktgerechtes Gehalt plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus
 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr
 Steuerfreie Benefits wie Essenszuschuss und Gutscheine
 Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen
 Offene und authentische Unternehmenskultur, geprägt durch Vertrauen, Respekt und Teamarbeit
 Hochwertige Ausstattung mit Apple-Geräten
 Gemeinsame Teamevents, wie unser jährliches Company-Retreat oder unsere Weihnachtsfeier
 So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess 
 Kennenlerngespräch, etwa 30 Minuten
 Fachgespräch, etwa 60 Minuten
 Kleine Fallstudie, etwa zwei bis drei Stunden, die du uns anschließend vorstellst
 Gespräch mit beiden Gründer:innen
 Nach jedem Schritt bekommst du zügig Rückmeldung von uns.
 Hast du Lust, die Arbeitssicherheit mit uns auf das nächste Level zu bringen? 
 Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Energy Product Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (
 42b EnWG).
 Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
 Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
 ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
 digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
 Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
Dein Profil
 Du hast bereits professionelle Erfahrung im Bereich Energy Management Systeme (EMS/HEMS) und/oder mit IoT- und Datenplattformen
 Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von Smart Metering, CLS/
 14a EnWG, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung oder Flexibilitätsvermarktung
 Du kannst technische Komplexität strukturieren und in klare Produktanforderungen, Roadmaps, Spezifikationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen übersetzen.
 Du bist stark in Research, Strukturierung und Entscheidungsfindung und kannst Make/Partner/Buy-Optionen fundiert aufbereiten.
 Du hast keine Berührungsängste mit regulatorischen Themen und kannst dich eigenständig in energiewirtschaftliche Fragestellungen einarbeiten.
 Du nutzt Daten und Metriken, um Hypothesen zu validieren, Prioritäten zu begründen und Produktentscheidungen messbar zu machen
 Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Energiewelt und Start-ups oder Immobilien mit
 Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
 Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
 Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend
 Deine Aufgaben
 Mission der Rolle
 Als Product Manager Energy bist du verantwortlich dafür, aufbauend auf unserer Smart-Meter- und CLS-Infrastruktur ein “first-of-its-kind” Energiemanagement- und Steuerungsprodukt zu entwickeln.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem COO sowie externen Partnern wie aEMT-, CLS-, GWA-, Hardware- und Software-Anbietern zusammen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, technische, regulatorische und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu verstehen und daraus eine klare Produkt-Roadmap, belastbare Spezifikationen und funktionierende Piloten abzuleiten.
 Produktentwicklung für Energy Intelligence (insb. EMS)
 Du übernimmst die produktseitige Verantwortung für unseren neuen Energy-Intelligence-Layer auf Basis von Smart Metern, CLS-Steuerboxen und steuerbaren Assets
 Du analysierst, welche Daten wir in welcher Granularität benötigen, z. B. Erzeugung, Verbrauch, Netzbezug, Einspeisung, Batteriestatus, Wärmepumpenlast, Wallbox-Verbrauch und Anlagenzustände
 Du entwickelst erste Steuerlogiken und Produktkonzepte für Use Cases wie Eigenverbrauchsoptimierung,
 14a-Steuerbarkeit, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung und perspektivisch Flexibilität/VPP
 Piloten, Partner und technische Konzeption
 Du hilfst uns, die Frage zu beantworten: Was bauen wir selbst, was machen wir mit Partnern, was kaufen oder integrieren wir?
 Du baust ein klares Verständnis dafür auf, welche Hardware-, Daten- und Steuerungsarchitektur wir für verschiedene Gebäudetypen und Asset-Kombinationen benötigen
 Du übersetzt energiewirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen in konkrete Produktanforderungen, User Stories, Datenmodelle, Schnittstellenanforderungen und Akzeptanzkriterien
 Markt, Regulierung und strategische Produktentwicklung
 Du beobachtest relevante regulatorische Entwicklungen, insbesondere rund um CLS,
 14a EnWG, Smart Metering, dynamische Tarife, Direktvermarktung, Energy Sharing und Flexibilität
 Du priorisierst Use Cases nach Kundennutzen, technischer Umsetzbarkeit, regulatorischer Relevanz und kommerziellem Potenzial
 Du managst gemeinsam mit Cedric (COO) und Martin (Head of Engineering) die Roadmap für unsere Energy-Produkte
 Benefits
 Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam
 Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
 Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
 Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
 Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten
 Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss
 Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist

title: Founder's Associate / Chief of Staff
description:
Finding a job these days is frustrating as f**k . So we flipped the job hunt concept on its head. With Generalyst, jobs find you, not the other way around.
 Startup founders reach out to us with their roles (often not found on the open market). We match you with the right ones for you, then guide you through the entire process – so you can nail your interviews & get an offer. Usually within a month.
 How does it work? 
 Apply to Generalyst – fill out a ~5min form and upload your CV. If it’s a fit, we’ll do a short virtual interview. Afterwards, you’ll be onboarded onto the program.
 Startup founders pitch to you – get an idea what working there is really like. A job description just doesn’t do it justice.
 Connect with high-growth startups in Germany – finding a job is a two-way street. Just as the startup needs to select you, you need to select the right startup to work with. Which means that on the program, you can both apply to startups AND receive applications from startups who think you’re a fantastic fit. Your profile will be in our candidate database, and >10 candidates have received applications FROM companies so far.
 Support to nail your interviews – we’ve done >1.000 interviews in our careers. Get actionable advice and preparation guides.
 On average, it takes ~4 weeks to receive an offer. Participation while working full-time is possible and encouraged!
 Based on previous experience placing Founder’s Associates in Germany, a few hard requirements apply:
 Permission to work in Germany
 Fluency in German (B2-Level and up)
 If you’re curious why German language is a hard criterion, there’s more info at the bottom.
 As we're also helping companies expand internationally, speaking another EU language natively is a plus (specifically Dutch, Spanish, Swedish, French, Italian, Polish).
 What is a Founder’s Associate? 
 Founder’s Associates are generalists that work directly with a company’s founder (usually the CEO) on strategic initiatives, marketing, operations, sales, fundraising, and more.
 This role is a fantastic opportunity to get to know the ins-and-outs of startup building. You’ll get an overview of a variety of business areas, allowing you to go deeper in fields that you’re curious about.
 Common progression opportunities include Chief of Staff (basically, a more senior generalist), individual contributor or even management (think: Head of X) positions in whichever field you feel comfortable in, or founding a startup yourself. Often, former Founder’s Associates make for the best founders.
 And a Chief of Staff? 
 Basically a more senior Founder's Associate with more special projects and potentially leadership responsibility. The definitions fluctuate a lot. Founder's Associates usually have 0-3 years of experiences, Chiefs of Staff 3-5 (or even more, depending on the stage of the company).
 Who are we looking for? 
 Our program is for early career generalists . If you don’t want to specialize in anything (yet), or want to get a broad overview of what building a startup is like, this program is for you.
 High Potential Recent Graduates – You just finished university, already ran a side hustle during university, were president of a students’ organization, or did a bunch of cool internships.
 Start-/Scale-Up Experience – You’ve worked in a startup before and are looking for your next career step.
 Consulting / IB / PE / VC Experience – You've worked in a high performance environment, but never had to take full accountability for the full consequences of your actions. Now, you want to get your hands dirty, take accountability and see the other side.
 Future & Former Founders – High potential generalists often make the best founders later on; and former founders often make for fantastic generalists.
 But most importantly, we care about your potential to succeed in a startup. Tell us about anything entrepreneurial that you’ve done so far, your failures and successes, and any cool achievements!
 Average salaries: 55-65k € for FA's, 70k-95k for Chief of Staff / Country Launcher profiles. (+ potential equity)
 How do I apply? 
 Apply in ~5min on our website.
 Interview with the Generalyst team
 Become part of the program
 What’s Generalyst? 
 Generalyst is the career accelerator for those who don’t want to specialize. We believe the future belongs to Generalists, and want to do our part in building up the generalist talent of the future.
 More info on our website: www.generalyst.de
 Why do you put such an emphasis on the German language? 
 ﻿ We work mostly with German startups. 
 About 90% of companies that we work with want to hire someone who speaks German. Which makes sense: they're based in Germany, and want a Swiss Army Knife – and sometimes this involves interfacing with authorities, writing grant applications, or directly interacting with German SMBs. All of this is easier done in German.
 This leads to a bad experience on both sides: candidates are frustrated because they don’t get to see interesting opportunities; companies are also frustrated because they think they’re pitching to 25 candidates, but in reality they’re pitching to 13 who do speak German.
 Now, if you’ve read this far and still want to be considered for the application – despite not speaking German – feel free to still apply. We reserve 20% of spots for super high potential, non-German speakers. :)
 A word on remote work 
 Look, I completely understand that working remotely is cool – I (Dominik, founder of Generalyst) run this business on a mostly remote basis too.
 However, the companies I work with are focused on in-office collaboration, and I have very few options that allow mostly for remote work. So full transparency: expect to be screened out if you're not willing to work inside an office for the majority of the week.

title: Founders Associate - Operations
description:

 Du übernimmst End-to-End Ownership für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und laufenden Betreuung
 Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben
 Du steuerst viele Projekte parallel und behältst eigenständig den Überblick, ohne, dass jemand dir hinterlaufen muss
 Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und kommunizierst schnell, klar und verbindlich
 Du löst operative Probleme eigenständig. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, suchst du nach einer Lösung, bis es klappt und schreckst auch nicht vor unkonventionellen Methoden zurück

 Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab
 Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Problemdefinition über die Umsetzung bis zur Erfolgsmessung
 Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Founder zusammen und übernimmst mit wachsendem Vertrauen zunehmend größere operative Verantwortungsbereiche.

 Wir suchen jemanden mit hohem Drive, starkem analytischem Denken und Lust darauf, früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen. 
 Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL, VWL, Finance, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.
 Erste relevante Erfahrungen durch Praktika in Startups, Venture Capital, Consulting, Investment Banking, Tech oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

 Du bist analytisch stark und kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten.
 Du kannst komplexe Probleme strukturieren und daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ableiten.
 Du bist sehr organisiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick.
 Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – auch mit Kunden und externen Partnern.
 Du hast hohe Eigenmotivation und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was du tun sollst.
 Du hast Spaß daran, dich in neue Tools und Technologien einzuarbeiten und Prozesse mit AI und Automatisierung besser zu machen.

 Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.

 Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

 Die Möglichkeit, mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche und perspektivisch ein eigenes Team zu übernehmen
 Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital
 Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
 Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen
